mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales and housing starts indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST both rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production growth above 0.5% monthly signals manufacturing expansion that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and CPI inflation signal aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL rising fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth exceeding 0.5% monthly indicates robust consumer spending that accelerates corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.
